in_hebrew.name: Bohun
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bohun הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old Slavic word ‘bogu’ meaning ‘god’ and ‘un’ meaning ‘protector’. In Slavic mythology, ‘Bohu’ was the name of the supreme god, also known as Perun, the god of thunder and sky.

in_greek.name: Bohun
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Bright protector
in_greek.long_meaning: Bohun είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old Slavic word ‘bogu’ meaning ‘god’ and ‘un’ meaning ‘protector’. In Slavic mythology, ‘Bohu’ was the name of the supreme god, also known as Perun, the god of thunder and sky.

in_latin.name: Bohun
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Bright protector
in_latin.long_meaning: Bohun est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old Slavic word ‘bogu’ meaning ‘god’ and ‘un’ meaning ‘protector’. In Slavic mythology, ‘Bohu’ was the name of the supreme god, also known as Perun, the god of thunder and sky.
